generationContracts.contract: DarwinActivity.group calls read(pid,pgid) without expected old birth. A newly discovered current member may be measured only after full PID/birth/state/effective-owner/PGID/counter validation. It is not correct to discard a new member solely for reusing a prior PID.
EPERM returns unavailable before BSD fallback or expected-generation resolution. Repeated PID-only tags cannot manufacture generation proof. Unknown remains unknown and totals remain null.

MacProcesses.rss calls read(pid,expected=record). A validated different birth or independently confirmed exit is gone only for that expected old generation. Permission, malformed identity and unavailable counters fail closed.

live compares current PID/birth then UID/executable/argv hash identity. finish re-describes and rechecks the full owned identity before its per-PID signal; replaced/changed/unknown identities are not accepted as owned.

Incomplete group activity fails before normal native_registry.census/outside RSS accounting. Registry finish may still run during cleanup. Therefore the sampled-RSS defect below cannot explain the original earlier group-activity EPERM.

validatedFinding.executionLimit: Method-level behavior was reproduced with synthetic same-identity process records. Actual PGID migration was not observed in either Mac run; no historical-cause attribution follows.
validatedFinding.problem: live verifies a current owned identity but returns the stored record. The old outside_group_rss classified inside/outside using the record PGID saved at registration. If the same owned generation changes group, it can omit unmeasured RSS or double-add RSS already sampled.
validatedFinding.repair: Runner passes the exact complete group sample birth tuples. The registry excludes only a full (pid,startSec,startUsec) already counted, independently of stored/current PGID. Uncounted owned generations retain expected-record RSS validation.
